name: Chengdu Hongming Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Chengdu Hongming Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the research, production, and sale of electronic components in China. The company offers multilayer ceramic, special ceramic, organic film, mica, and other capacitors; and displacement sensors, power filters, connectors, microwave devices, and precision components. It also provides precision wire wound, precision conductive plastic, precision glass enamel, and non-contact linear and angular displacement sensors; electromagnetic compatibility design; positive and negative temperature coefficient thermistors, diverter, power resistor, attenuator; high energy density pulse capacitors; high power pulse capacitors; and connectors, such as filter, …
